Books on Israel and Palestine (Fiction and Nonfiction)

A list of fiction and non-fiction books about Palestine and its people: history, culture, identity, conflict, resistance, suffering, justice, and apartheid.

This reading list was inspired by the Goodreads Listopia: ‘Best Books about Palestine’ curated by user Ofer Engel and the Goodreads community.
